payload.detail: Progress 2026-08-15: PR #1965 landed on main (commit 3ec6116) and closes the false-OK gap for the pinned Chromium revision by resolving the effective cache and requiring a launchable binary. Keep this issue open: the unscoped test:e2e and release matrix also require Firefox and WebKit, and the check does not yet report whether their locked revisions are installed. Next: enumerate required and installed revisions for all browser families, with a Chromium-only-cache regression; project-scoped --project=chromium runs may continue to require Chromium alone.
